# Culmina — shared agent instructions

Culmina is a Flutter/Dart Android astrophotography planner and observing log.
The technical Dart package is `astroplan`; keep existing imports and identifiers.
Plan a night, site, target and rig; save a Capture Plan; record imaging results.
The app does not control cameras or mounts.

## Source and scope

- This file is the shared instruction source for Codex, Claude and Gemini.
- Follow the current user task; skills and archived findings are not a task queue.
- Establish behavior from current source and tests before editing docs or code.
- Read only the relevant skill and supporting reference for the requested work.
- Keep new or substantially revised project documentation in English.
- Preserve unrelated local changes and historical evidence; report checks actually performed.

## Architecture map

- `lib/main.dart`: startup, catalog seeding and concrete dependency composition.
- `lib/presentation/app_view_models.dart`: injected interfaces, services and ViewModels.
- `lib/presentation/`: screens, shared UI, widgets and screen-scoped Provider/ViewModels.
- `lib/presentation/navigation/app_router.dart`: go_router shell and root overlay routes.
- Bottom tabs: Tonight, Logbook, Library and Settings; Plan opens above the shell.
- Library contains rigs, targets and sites; Night, Moon and Weather have detail views.
- `lib/domain/`: models, repository interfaces and astronomical/capture calculations.
- `lib/data/`: Drift repositories, preferences, HTTP, backup and platform adapters.
- `lib/core/`: clocks/time, units, diagnostics, configuration and theme tokens.
- `lib/data/database/app_database.dart`: native SQLite database, currently schema v27.
- `lib/data/database/schema_versions.dart` and `lib/data/database/generated_migrations/`: migrations.
- `drift_schemas/`: exported JSON snapshots; `build.yaml` configures Drift generation.
- `assets/catalog/catalog_v2.json`: bundled OpenNGC subset; filename is not catalog version.
- `test/`: core/data/domain/presentation regressions; `test/support/` contains shared fakes.
- `integration_test/` and `test_driver/`: host flows and separate Android capture routes.
- `tool/`: verification, CI partitioning, catalog generation and design helper scripts.
- `design/reference/`: consolidated design rules website, current application map, historical Atlas, shared assets and render evidence. Start at `design/reference/index.html`.
- `design/reference/atlas/index.html`: historical Visual Atlas; manifest, boards and captures accompany it. `.audit/atlas/index.html` redirects here.
- `.audit/` and `docs/archive/`: historical evidence; inspect as needed, preserve contents.
- `.agents/skills/`: active project recipes; `.agents/rules/` holds compatibility pointers.

## Technical invariants

- Keep UI, ViewModels, domain interfaces/calculations and data implementations separated.
- Reuse Provider, repository injection and existing router/draft guards for focused changes.
- Keep catalogs, saved plans, calculations and Logbook useful offline.
- Forecast retrieval, map tiles and optional place-name lookup need network access.
- Preserve weather cache/freshness/error states and opt-in reverse-geocoding consent.
- Unknown is not zero: preserve missing values, units, provenance and partial observations.
- Never invent sensor specifications, catalog values, measurements or a quality score.
- Relative stacking gain is not absolute SNR; storage estimates retain their evidence kind.
- AF/MF and white balance are descriptive; do not invent numeric focus measurements.
- SessionNight is 24 hours from site mean solar noon in UTC; retain zone/DST display semantics.
- A placeholder location is not a selected site; preserve no-site and missing-input states.
- CaptureBudgetCalculator and FitAnalyzer share atomic events; keep timing assumptions aligned.
- Preserve draft, explicit Save plan, fit verdict and recorded-result distinctions.
- Preserve local records, supported migrations and backup/restore compatibility.
- Maintain Light, Dark and Field Red, including the root field color filter.
- Theme definitions live in `lib/core/theme/`; inspect semantic roles and actual callers.
- Use existing Geist typography, spacing, radii and reduced-motion handling for local UI fixes.
- Keep meaningful words, accessible actions, text scaling and reachable controls.

## Commands and verification

Run from the repository root with Flutter/Dart on PATH and resolved dependencies.
`pubspec.yaml` requires Dart `^3.13.3`; CI pins its SDK in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.
Inspect the installed SDK and lockfile; do not upgrade dependencies as a bootstrap step.

```sh
flutter pub get
flutter run
flutter analyze --no-pub
flutter test --no-pub
flutter test --no-pub test/data/database/schema_migration_test.dart
dart run build_runner build
dart run drift_dev schema steps drift_schemas/ lib/data/database/schema_versions.dart
flutter build apk --debug
```

- Code generation changes files: run for changed database inputs and inspect the diff.
- Preserve older schema snapshots; test migrations against supported stored databases.
- Format changed Dart files; select tests from changed behavior and its callers.
- `dart run tool/check.dart --checks-only` runs encoding, formatting and analysis checks.
- `dart run tool/check.dart` also runs unit tests and each host-capable integration file.
- CI implementation/job selection live in `tool/ci.py` and `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.
- Run host integration files separately; Android-only capture tests need an Android device.
- For instruction-only edits, validate paths, frontmatter and diffs; app checks are optional.

Instruction tooling uses Python with `tool/requirements-instructions.txt`:
`python -m pip install -r tool/requirements-instructions.txt`, then
`python tool/check_instructions.py` and
`python -m unittest discover -s tool -p check_instructions_test.py -v`.
CI runs these in the changes job, including documentation-only changes.
The validator checks active skill YAML and local Markdown file references in
the root entrypoints, `.agents/` and `.claude/`; it does not check remote URLs,
heading anchors, code-span paths or agent behavior. Behavioral review cases and
their evidence requirements are in [skill evals](tool/skill_evals/README.md).

Native UI renders in PowerShell (synthetic fixtures; fresh evidence goes to build):

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path build/ui-renders -Force | Out-Null
$env:CULMINA_AUDIT_RENDERS = 'build/ui-renders'
$env:CULMINA_AUDIT_SHOTS = 'home,plan'
$env:CULMINA_AUDIT_THEMES = 'light,dark,field'
$env:CULMINA_AUDIT_SCALE = '1'
flutter test --no-pub test/presentation/design_system/concept_b_app_audit_renders_test.dart
Remove-Item Env:CULMINA_AUDIT_RENDERS, Env:CULMINA_AUDIT_SHOTS, Env:CULMINA_AUDIT_THEMES, Env:CULMINA_AUDIT_SCALE
```

The harness loads real fonts and uses in-memory state; inspect supported shot names.
The archived Atlas has 40 Dark/100%/375×812 captures with dated source provenance.
Check its manifest before reusing frames; archive presence does not prove current behavior.
Keep browser, Flutter host, Android/device, accessibility and owner acceptance evidence distinct.

For meaningful product-design refinement, use a brief
[decision record](.agents/skills/references/refinement-decision.md) in the existing
task or review: user problem, intended benefit, observable success, matched
before/after evidence, actual checks and the accept/revise/reject decision.
Scale the record to the change; this adds no separate approval gate.

## Active project skills

### Design authority and supporting tools

The five `culmina-design-*` skills below are the only project design authorities
for all UI code: screens, shared and composed widgets, scientific displays,
dialogs, states and all three themes. Use the relevant skills during implementation;
their scope is not limited to the component gallery. AGENTS supplies shared
invariants; current source/callers and tests establish actual behavior.
References and `docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` support these skills, not parallel policy.
Fill a design-guidance gap in the relevant Culmina skill instead of adopting an
external playbook or inventing another design authority.

diagnosis, previews and tests. Context7 supplies external API documentation.

Generic design/audit, brand and palette playbooks are archived for this project.
See [agent tooling](docs/AGENT_TOOLING.md) for retained helpers, archive and plugin evidence.
Installed or enabled plugins do not prove authentication, invocation or acceptance.

## Current external documentation

Use Context7 for library/framework/SDK/API/CLI questions, including unfamiliar flags.
Resolve the library ID first unless the user supplies an exact `/org/project` ID.
Choose an authoritative/version-matched result, then query one concept per call.
Use fetched docs with the installed SDK and actual callers; disclose failed lookups.
General code reasoning and source-only refactors need no library-documentation lookup.

# Design system

This is a reference to the implemented Flutter UI in `lib/`.
It does not assert visual or accessibility acceptance.

## Design guidance structure

The five local Culmina design skills are the only project design authorities.
They cover all UI code, including screens, composed widgets, scientific displays,
dialogs, states and all themes; the gallery is only a scoped visual inventory.
Use the relevant skills during implementation. Supporting references and
implementation files are not additional rule sets. Extend the relevant Culmina
skill when guidance is missing. Technical and artifact helpers remain available
as described in [agent tooling](AGENT_TOOLING.md).
Shared product invariants remain in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).

| Local skill | Owns |
| --- | --- |
| [Components](../.agents/skills/culmina-design-components/SKILL.md) | Existing components, states, callbacks and actual adopters |
| [Product rules](../.agents/skills/culmina-design-rules/SKILL.md) | Scientific meaning, time, missing data and persistence distinctions |
| [Spacing](../.agents/skills/culmina-design-spacing/SKILL.md) | Local geometry, shape, density and reduced motion |
| [Tokens](../.agents/skills/culmina-design-tokens/SKILL.md) | Semantic colors and surfaces across all three themes |
| [Typography](../.agents/skills/culmina-design-typography/SKILL.md) | Adopted text roles, wrapping, scaling and numeric readability |

This document indexes the implementation. The skills' supporting references route
to current definitions and callers. Compatibility files in `.agents/rules/` point
back to shared guidance; external design playbooks and archived recipes are not
automatically adopted Culmina policy. A component specimen demonstrates appearance
in its captured state, not production adoption or device acceptance.

## Theme sources

- `core/theme/app_theme.dart`: Light, Dark and red Field `ThemeData`.
- `app_colors.dart`: raw colors; `app_palette.dart`: semantic theme extension.
- `hybrid_tokens.dart`: additional surfaces, selection, feedback, chart colors,
  compact type sizes, minimum target and app-bar height.
- `app_typography.dart`, `app_spacing.dart`, `app_radius.dart`,
  `app_motion.dart`: type, spacing, shape and transition values.
- `app_button_styles.dart`: shared button styling.

`DisplaySettingsViewModel` stores System/Light/Dark appearance and display
choices. `ThemeViewModel` stores field mode separately. `main.dart` selects
the theme and applies `AppTheme.fieldFilter` around app content in field mode.

## Layout, shape and motion

- `AppSpacing`: 4, 8, 16, 24, 32, 48; page gutter 20 and section gap 28.
  Additional compact steps are 2, 3, 6, 10, 12 and 14.
- `AppRadius`: small 6, menu 8, large 12 and pill 999.
- `HybridTokens`: minimum target 48; app bar height 64.
- `AppMotion`: short 120 ms, medium 180 ms, highlight 1500 ms;
  curve `Cubic(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`.
  Its duration helper returns zero when platform animations are disabled.
- `AppShell`: four navigation items with minimum height 56;
  at text scale 1.5 or greater it lays them out two per row.

## Shared UI

`presentation/shared/` contains the app bar, line icons, section headers,
collapsible sections, detail scaffold, status/failure feedback, confirmation
and deletion patterns, field-mode control and form-input helpers.
`presentation/widgets/` contains altitude/night/weather visualizations,
capture planning, budgets, fit/status and storage/gain presentation.
Screen-specific layouts live under `presentation/screens/`.

The current composition is Tonight → separate Plan/detail flows, with
Logbook, Library and Settings as other root destinations.
Labels, unknown-data messages and draft/result distinctions come from
shared text helpers and the relevant screen/ViewModel state.

See [Product specification](PRODUCT_SPEC.md) and [Architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md).

# A focused refinement decision

Use for a named Culmina product-design refinement that changes a meaningful
hierarchy, interaction or visual decision. Keep the record in the existing task,
review or PR; a new document is optional. A small alignment correction does not
need a full product study. The current user request sets scope and authorization.

Record enough to evaluate the proposed benefit:

| Question | Evidence to retain |
| --- | --- |
| What user problem are we addressing? | A concrete step in the planning or result-recording task and observed friction; label an untested concern as a hypothesis. |
| Why should this change help? | The intended improvement in comprehension, readability or action, and why the existing component/composition is insufficient. |
| What must stay true? | Relevant product/data invariants, state distinctions and actual source/caller; do not invent science or change calculations for appearance. |
| What counts as success? | Observable criteria appropriate to the task, such as full labels at the affected scaler, a reachable action, or users distinguishing time fit from saved state. Do not fabricate usability results or universal numerical thresholds. |
| Is the comparison fair? | Before/after with the same data, state, viewport, text scale, theme and fonts; disclose differences and synthetic fixtures. Missing baseline evidence remains a limit. |
| What was checked? | Relevant themes, phone constraints, large text, states and interactions. Keep source review, host renders, Android, screen reader and human judgment separate. Select checks from the actual change. |
| What was decided? | Accept, revise or reject, with the reason and remaining uncertainty. Record owner acceptance only when given; an agent recommendation is not owner approval. |

For reviews, report findings without implementing them. For authorized changes,
complete the scoped work and appropriate checks; this record adds no extra
approval gate. If a visual direction requires a user choice, retain the proposal
and the pending decision rather than presenting it as adopted.

The main outcome is whether the user can understand the viable night/target,
configure the plan, explain its fit, deliberately save it and later record the
actual result. Reuse current components and focused skills; the record does not
authorize a redesign, new toolchain or additional dependencies.

# Culmina product and data rules

Use when a UI task affects product meaning, scientific inputs, missing data or persistence. Start from [AGENTS](../../../AGENTS.md), the affected screen/ViewModel and domain service; current code supplies behavior, while the user supplies task scope.

- Culmina plans astrophotography and records outcomes; it does not control cameras or mounts. Preserve that boundary and avoid invented quality scores.
- Trace nightly calculations through `lib/domain/services/` and time models through `lib/domain/models/`. Keep UTC instants separate from civil evening dates and site-zone/DST presentation. A placeholder location is not a chosen observing site.
- Unknown is not zero. Retain units, source/freshness and theoretical versus empirical storage meaning. Relative stacking gain is not absolute SNR; AF/MF describes focusing and supplies no numeric focus measurement.
- Preserve Capture Plan assumptions, calibration policies, exposure/filter groups and fit reasons. Follow actual camera-class validation rather than hiding inconvenient inputs.
- Fit, working draft, explicitly saved plan and recorded result are distinct. Trace state through `lib/presentation/viewmodels/` and actual confirmation/caller behavior; keep Save/Discard/Cancel and failure recovery.
- Core planning, catalog and local records must remain usable offline. Preserve cache timestamps and missing/stale weather distinctions. Label illustrative fixtures as examples.
- Support Light, Dark and Field Red using `lib/core/theme/` and the field filter in `lib/main.dart`. Inspect pairing/readability in the intended theme; source colors alone do not establish accessibility acceptance.

Use `design/reference/atlas/` only as historical visual evidence and identify its captured state. It supplies neither current implementation requirements nor approval for a new direction. The `design/reference/` website documents the system with browser specimens; these do not establish native behavior.

Report the affected invariant, owning source/caller, change or review finding, checks and remaining limits. Keep unrelated findings separate from the requested implementation.

# Culmina spacing, shape and motion

Use for local spacing, alignment, density, radius, border and functional-motion work. Read [AGENTS](../../../AGENTS.md), the affected widget/callers and the relevant definitions in `lib/core/theme/app_spacing.dart`, `app_radius.dart` and `app_motion.dart`.

- Distinguish scale values, component padding and screen gutters. `md=16`, `gutter=20` and `section=28` are available values, not instructions to normalize every screen.
- Inspect actual screen padding and chart/calendar width constraints before adjusting a gap. `DocumentSection` in `lib/presentation/shared/document_section.dart` supplies flat grouping, default 16 dp padding and 8 dp corners; preserve child actions, focus and natural text height.
- Improve grouping before shrinking text. Diagnose width/height and scrolling ownership before adding flex or wrapping; use [layout diagnosis](../flutter-fix-layout-issues/SKILL.md) for an actual constraint error.
- Preserve reachable controls, full labels, text scaling and large-content scrolling. Avoid clipping, fixed text-card heights or a smaller user scaler as overflow repairs.
- Read shape values from AppRadius: small 6, menu 8, large 12, pill 999. Inspect the caller's current role before changing it.
- Use AppMotion and its reduced-motion handling. Source-owned scientific sky ramps and stacking-gain gradients are functional data presentation, not permission to add decorative effects.

A phone overflow does not call for new navigation or an adaptive shell. Use the named adaptive-layout skill only for that task.

Report the geometry/source/caller, chosen correction, actual checks and limits. A static render establishes only its captured theme, size, scale and state.

# Culmina semantic colors and surfaces

Use for theme/surface meaning, Field Red behavior and token drift. Read [AGENTS](../../../AGENTS.md), the needed rows of the [semantic map](references/semantic-map.md), and affected definitions/callers in `lib/core/theme/app_colors.dart`, `app_palette.dart`, `hybrid_tokens.dart` and `app_theme.dart`.

1. Identify the role: page/group/overlay surface, text, control boundary, science display, fit or persistence/result state. Follow the actual caller to its theme owner; a token declaration is not proof of use.
2. Reuse the existing semantic role before adding an alias. Similar names/values in AppPalette and HybridTokens do not require migrating every caller.
   Keep raw color values and preset construction inside `lib/core/theme/`. Runtime custom roles, including the launch mark, are ThemeExtensions installed in ThemeData; presentation reads the active extension. Implement field-preserving copyWith and continuous lerp for custom theme properties. The launch gate supplies a theme before the main app is ready; do not recreate a separate presentation palette.
3. Preserve words, icons and geometry alongside functional colors. Unknown, freshness, fit and saved/result meanings remain distinct.
4. Inspect affected foreground/background pairs in Light, Dark and Field Red. Keep red/black field presentation and the production filter in `lib/main.dart`; evaluate accessibility against actual rendered uses rather than assuming all themes meet a threshold.
5. For an explicitly requested palette exploration, compare identical content/state and record the proposal separately from implementation. `design/reference/atlas/` is historical visual evidence; `design/reference/` documents source-owned tokens and is not a separate token authority.

Report the semantic role, definition/caller, affected theme pairings, changes or findings, checks and limits. Browser specimens and host renders do not establish Android/device or owner acceptance.

name: culmina-design-typography

# Culmina typography

Use for text hierarchy, roles, weight, line height, wrapping and readable measurements. Read [AGENTS](../../../AGENTS.md), `lib/core/theme/app_typography.dart`, relevant compact roles in `hybrid_tokens.dart`, bundled assets in `pubspec.yaml` and affected text callers.

- Production text roles use Geist. Source Serif 4 remains bundled; its availability is not evidence of current role adoption. Preserve MaterialIcons and the separate line-icon rendering path.
- Read Material roles through `Theme.of(context).textTheme` and Culmina-specific roles through `AppTextTheme.of(context)`. `AppTypography` defines the central base scale; presentation does not read its static styles. Named roles and the Material TextTheme have distinct purposes.
- Keep font sizes, line heights, tracking and family declarations in the theme layer. Reuse the named role or a central `AppTextGeometry` preset through `AppTextTheme.resolve`; local `copyWith` may change semantic color, weight or numeric features, not geometry. Preserve existing dimensions when consolidating a role rather than silently normalizing screens.
- Diagnose available width, wrapping and padding before shrinking text. Preserve the user's text scaler and full accessible labels. Compact chart/calendar/navigation roles are explicit exceptions in current source, not a global size prescription.
- Check long names, errors, units and signs, ambiguous digits, and relevant Ukrainian glyphs (І і Ї ї Є є Ґ ґ). Use actual bundled fonts for visual evidence and tabular numerals where comparative measurements need them.
- Font-family selection applies only to a named family/design task. Compare identical content/composition, retain license/provenance and verify fallback; do not download or refresh assets as a side effect of a wrapping fix.

Report the role/caller, bounded correction or finding, checks and remaining limits. CSS specimens do not prove Flutter scaling, and static renders do not establish device or owner acceptance.

# Data display: API and state map

Paths are relative to the repository root. Unqualified shared filenames are under `lib/presentation/shared/`; `widgets/` means `lib/presentation/widgets/`. Values come from existing domain/ViewModel contracts.

| API/source | Inputs, variants and slots | State and interaction contract | Adopter/check |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DocumentSection` in `document_section.dart` | Required existing `children`; optional padding (16 dp), joinPrevious/joinNext for lazy month slices | Flat surfaceSubtle, radius 8 dp, zero elevation. No new callback, clipping, semantic merging or fixed text height. Local Material preserves child ink/focus feedback. Keep source-owned chart/calendar widths and all existing actions | Tonight, Plan, Logbook, Night, Moon, Weather, Library, Settings, Record result; `test/presentation/shared/document_section_test.dart` |
| `SkyDarknessWidget` in `widgets/sky_darkness_widget.dart` | `embedded:false` keeps standalone framing; `embedded:true` uses the containing document group's frame/inset | Same remembered disclosure key, top sibling rule, Bortle/SQM/Unknown, independent provenance, picker and external-map action in both variants | Planner `home_screen.dart` uses embedded; `sky_darkness_context_test.dart` covers standalone facts and embedded control/persistence behavior |
| `StatusBlock` in `lib/presentation/shared/status_block.dart` | Required `state:FitState`; optional `needed/usable:Duration?`, `reason`, `missing`, `keyNumbers:List<(String,String)>`, `action:Widget?` | Only show measured headline when both durations exist. Missing input uses its word, never fabricated zero. Action slot is caller-owned; the widget calculates nothing | `test/presentation/shared/status_block_test.dart`; Tonight instance; planner `plan_status.dart` uses `StatusBlock.headline` only; isolated trial |

    selected,
    chartDay,
    chartTwilight,
    chartDark,
    chartWindow,
    chartTarget,
    chartMoon,
    chartMinAltitude,
    chartNow,
    chartNowCentre,
    chartGrid,
    chartLabel,
    swatchBorder,
    ...bortle,
    ...onBortle,
  ];

  @override
  AppPalette copyWith({
    bool? fieldMode,
    Brightness? brightness,
    Color? textPrimary,
    Color? textSecondary,
    Color? textTertiary,
    Color? textDisabled,
    Color? surfaceRaised,
    Color? border,
    Color? controlBorder,
    Color? statusFits,
    Color? statusTight,
    Color? statusDoesNotFit,
    Color? statusNoWindow,
    Color? statusNeutral,
    Color? stateUnsaved,
    Color? stateSettled,
    Color? stateQuiet,
    Color? muted,
    Color? caution,
    Color? sunEvent,
    Color? twilightEvent,
    Color? moon,
    Color? selected,
    Color? chartDay,
    Color? chartTwilight,
    Color? chartDark,
    Color? chartWindow,
    Color? chartTarget,
    Color? chartMoon,
    Color? chartMinAltitude,
    Color? chartNow,
    Color? chartNowCentre,
    Color? chartGrid,
    Color? chartLabel,
    Color? swatchBorder,
    List<Color>? bortle,
    List<Color>? onBortle,
  }) => AppPalette(
    fieldMode: fieldMode ?? this.fieldMode,
    brightness: brightness ?? this.brightness,
    textPrimary: textPrimary ?? this.textPrimary,
    textSecondary: textSecondary ?? this.textSecondary,
    textTertiary: textTertiary ?? this.textTertiary,
    textDisabled: textDisabled ?? this.textDisabled,
    surfaceRaised: surfaceRaised ?? this.surfaceRaised,
    border: border ?? this.border,
    controlBorder: controlBorder ?? this.controlBorder,
    statusFits: statusFits ?? this.statusFits,
    statusTight: statusTight ?? this.statusTight,
    statusDoesNotFit: statusDoesNotFit ?? this.statusDoesNotFit,
    statusNoWindow: statusNoWindow ?? this.statusNoWindow,
    statusNeutral: statusNeutral ?? this.statusNeutral,
    stateUnsaved: stateUnsaved ?? this.stateUnsaved,
    stateSettled: stateSettled ?? this.stateSettled,
    stateQuiet: stateQuiet ?? this.stateQuiet,
    muted: muted ?? this.muted,
    caution: caution ?? this.caution,
    sunEvent: sunEvent ?? this.sunEvent,
    twilightEvent: twilightEvent ?? this.twilightEvent,
    moon: moon ?? this.moon,
    selected: selected ?? this.selected,
    chartDay: chartDay ?? this.chartDay,
    chartTwilight: chartTwilight ?? this.chartTwilight,
    chartDark: chartDark ?? this.chartDark,
    chartWindow: chartWindow ?? this.chartWindow,
    chartTarget: chartTarget ?? this.chartTarget,
    chartMoon: chartMoon ?? this.chartMoon,
    chartMinAltitude: chartMinAltitude ?? this.chartMinAltitude,
    chartNow: chartNow ?? this.chartNow,
    chartNowCentre: chartNowCentre ?? this.chartNowCentre,
    chartGrid: chartGrid ?? this.chartGrid,
    chartLabel: chartLabel ?? this.chartLabel,
    swatchBorder: swatchBorder ?? this.swatchBorder,
    bortle: bortle ?? this.bortle,
    onBortle: onBortle ?? this.onBortle,
  );

  @override
  AppPalette lerp(AppPalette? other, double t) {
    if (other == null || t == 0) return this;
    if (t == 1) return other;
    assert(bortle.length == other.bortle.length);
    assert(onBortle.length == other.onBortle.length);
    return AppPalette(
      fieldMode: t < .5 ? fieldMode : other.fieldMode,
      brightness: t < .5 ? brightness : other.brightness,
      textPrimary: Color.lerp(textPrimary, other.textPrimary, t)!,
      textSecondary: Color.lerp(textSecondary, other.textSecondary, t)!,
      textTertiary: Color.lerp(textTertiary, other.textTertiary, t)!,
      textDisabled: Color.lerp(textDisabled, other.textDisabled, t)!,
      surfaceRaised: Color.lerp(surfaceRaised, other.surfaceRaised, t)!,
      border: Color.lerp(border, other.border, t)!,
      controlBorder: Color.lerp(controlBorder, other.controlBorder, t)!,
      statusFits: Color.lerp(statusFits, other.statusFits, t)!,
      statusTight: Color.lerp(statusTight, other.statusTight, t)!,
      statusDoesNotFit: Color.lerp(
        statusDoesNotFit,
        other.statusDoesNotFit,
        t,
      )!,
      statusNoWindow: Color.lerp(statusNoWindow, other.statusNoWindow, t)!,
      statusNeutral: Color.lerp(statusNeutral, other.statusNeutral, t)!,
      stateUnsaved: Color.lerp(stateUnsaved, other.stateUnsaved, t)!,
      stateSettled: Color.lerp(stateSettled, other.stateSettled, t)!,
      stateQuiet: Color.lerp(stateQuiet, other.stateQuiet, t)!,
      muted: Color.lerp(muted, other.muted, t)!,
      caution: Color.lerp(caution, other.caution, t)!,
      sunEvent: Color.lerp(sunEvent, other.sunEvent, t)!,
      twilightEvent: Color.lerp(twilightEvent, other.twilightEvent, t)!,
      moon: Color.lerp(moon, other.moon, t)!,
      selected: Color.lerp(selected, other.selected, t)!,
      chartDay: Color.lerp(chartDay, other.chartDay, t)!,
      chartTwilight: Color.lerp(chartTwilight, other.chartTwilight, t)!,
      chartDark: Color.lerp(chartDark, other.chartDark, t)!,
      chartWindow: Color.lerp(chartWindow, other.chartWindow, t)!,
      chartTarget: Color.lerp(chartTarget, other.chartTarget, t)!,
      chartMoon: Color.lerp(chartMoon, other.chartMoon, t)!,
      chartMinAltitude: Color.lerp(
        chartMinAltitude,
        other.chartMinAltitude,
        t,
      )!,
      chartNow: Color.lerp(chartNow, other.chartNow, t)!,
      chartNowCentre: Color.lerp(chartNowCentre, other.chartNowCentre, t)!,
      chartGrid: Color.lerp(chartGrid, other.chartGrid, t)!,
      chartLabel: Color.lerp(chartLabel, other.chartLabel, t)!,
      swatchBorder: Color.lerp(swatchBorder, other.swatchBorder, t)!,
      bortle: List.generate(
        bortle.length,
        (i) => Color.lerp(bortle[i], other.bortle[i], t)!,
      ),
      onBortle: List.generate(
        onBortle.length,
        (i) => Color.lerp(onBortle[i], other.onBortle[i], t)!,
      ),
    );
  }
}

rules.text: Use for composing, correcting or documenting existing Flutter controls and displays. Read [AGENTS](../../../AGENTS.md) and inspect the affected source/caller before choosing a component.
Field, action, choice, confirmation or deletion · [Forms](references/forms.md) · Units, validation, edited drafts and Save/Discard/Cancel
Context actions, detail template or destination · [Navigation](references/navigation.md) · Actual route adoption, Back/state and no-site semantics
Fit/state, disclosure, measurement or science graphic · [Data display](references/data-display.md) · Unknown, fit versus persistence/result state and source-owned calculations

Read only the relevant group. Reuse the current component before adding an abstraction; inspect loading, missing-input, disabled, error and saved/changed states. Component availability or a gallery example does not prove production adoption.

For a changed contract, describe its purpose, inputs, states, interactions, semantics and real adopter. Preserve full labels, reachable actions, natural text growth and existing theme roles. A local component fix does not imply a routing redesign.
Report the source/caller, changed behavior, actual checks and limits. Native host renders, Android/device interaction and owner acceptance are separate evidence.

For meaningful product-design refinement, use the shared [decision record](../references/refinement-decision.md) to make the intended benefit and acceptance evidence explicit; keep small corrections proportional.

Use when a UI task affects product meaning, scientific inputs, missing data or persistence. Start from [AGENTS](../../../AGENTS.md), the affected screen/ViewModel and domain service; current code supplies behavior, while the user supplies task scope.
Culmina plans astrophotography and records outcomes; it does not control cameras or mounts. Preserve that boundary and avoid invented quality scores.

Trace nightly calculations through `lib/domain/services/` and time models through `lib/domain/models/`. Keep UTC instants separate from civil evening dates and site-zone/DST presentation. A placeholder location is not a chosen observing site.

Unknown is not zero. Retain units, source/freshness and theoretical versus empirical storage meaning. Relative stacking gain is not absolute SNR; AF/MF describes focusing and supplies no numeric focus measurement.
Preserve Capture Plan assumptions, calibration policies, exposure/filter groups and fit reasons. Follow actual camera-class validation rather than hiding inconvenient inputs.

Fit, working draft, explicitly saved plan and recorded result are distinct. Trace state through `lib/presentation/viewmodels/` and actual confirmation/caller behavior; keep Save/Discard/Cancel and failure recovery.
Core planning, catalog and local records must remain usable offline. Preserve cache timestamps and missing/stale weather distinctions. Label illustrative fixtures as examples.

Support Light, Dark and Field Red using `lib/core/theme/` and the field filter in `lib/main.dart`. Inspect pairing/readability in the intended theme; source colors alone do not establish accessibility acceptance.

Use `design/reference/atlas/` only as historical visual evidence and identify its captured state. It supplies neither current implementation requirements nor approval for a new direction. The `design/reference/` website documents the system with browser specimens; these do not establish native behavior.
Report the affected invariant, owning source/caller, change or review finding, checks and remaining limits. Keep unrelated findings separate from the requested implementation.

Use for local spacing, alignment, density, radius, border and functional-motion work. Read [AGENTS](../../../AGENTS.md), the affected widget/callers and the relevant definitions in `lib/core/theme/app_spacing.dart`, `app_radius.dart` and `app_motion.dart`.
Distinguish scale values, component padding and screen gutters. `md=16`, `gutter=20` and `section=28` are available values, not instructions to normalize every screen.

Inspect actual screen padding and chart/calendar width constraints before adjusting a gap. `DocumentSection` in `lib/presentation/shared/document_section.dart` supplies flat grouping, default 16 dp padding and 8 dp corners; preserve child actions, focus and natural text height.

Improve grouping before shrinking text. Diagnose width/height and scrolling ownership before adding flex or wrapping; use [layout diagnosis](../flutter-fix-layout-issues/SKILL.md) for an actual constraint error.
Preserve reachable controls, full labels, text scaling and large-content scrolling. Avoid clipping, fixed text-card heights or a smaller user scaler as overflow repairs.
Read shape values from AppRadius: small 6, menu 8, large 12, pill 999. Inspect the caller's current role before changing it.
Use AppMotion and its reduced-motion handling. Source-owned scientific sky ramps and stacking-gain gradients are functional data presentation, not permission to add decorative effects.
A phone overflow does not call for new navigation or an adaptive shell. Use the named adaptive-layout skill only for that task.
Report the geometry/source/caller, chosen correction, actual checks and limits. A static render establishes only its captured theme, size, scale and state.

Use for theme/surface meaning, Field Red behavior and token drift. Read [AGENTS](../../../AGENTS.md), the needed rows of the [semantic map](references/semantic-map.md), and affected definitions/callers in `lib/core/theme/app_colors.dart`, `app_palette.dart`, `hybrid_tokens.dart` and `app_theme.dart`.

Identify the role: page/group/overlay surface, text, control boundary, science display, fit or persistence/result state. Follow the actual caller to its theme owner; a token declaration is not proof of use.
Reuse the existing semantic role before adding an alias. Similar names/values in AppPalette and HybridTokens do not require migrating every caller.

Keep raw color values and preset construction inside `lib/core/theme/`. Runtime custom roles, including the launch mark, are ThemeExtensions installed in ThemeData; presentation reads the active extension. Implement field-preserving copyWith and continuous lerp for custom theme properties. The launch gate supplies a theme before the main app is ready; do not recreate a separate presentation palette.
Preserve words, icons and geometry alongside functional colors. Unknown, freshness, fit and saved/result meanings remain distinct.

Inspect affected foreground/background pairs in Light, Dark and Field Red. Keep red/black field presentation and the production filter in `lib/main.dart`; evaluate accessibility against actual rendered uses rather than assuming all themes meet a threshold.

For an explicitly requested palette exploration, compare identical content/state and record the proposal separately from implementation. `design/reference/atlas/` is historical visual evidence; `design/reference/` documents source-owned tokens and is not a separate token authority.
Report the semantic role, definition/caller, affected theme pairings, changes or findings, checks and limits. Browser specimens and host renders do not establish Android/device or owner acceptance.

Use for text hierarchy, roles, weight, line height, wrapping and readable measurements. Read [AGENTS](../../../AGENTS.md), `lib/core/theme/app_typography.dart`, relevant compact roles in `hybrid_tokens.dart`, bundled assets in `pubspec.yaml` and affected text callers.
Production text roles use Geist. Source Serif 4 remains bundled; its availability is not evidence of current role adoption. Preserve MaterialIcons and the separate line-icon rendering path.

Read Material roles through `Theme.of(context).textTheme` and Culmina-specific roles through `AppTextTheme.of(context)`. `AppTypography` defines the central base scale; presentation does not read its static styles. Named roles and the Material TextTheme have distinct purposes.

Keep font sizes, line heights, tracking and family declarations in the theme layer. Reuse the named role or a central `AppTextGeometry` preset through `AppTextTheme.resolve`; local `copyWith` may change semantic color, weight or numeric features, not geometry. Preserve existing dimensions when consolidating a role rather than silently normalizing screens.

Diagnose available width, wrapping and padding before shrinking text. Preserve the user's text scaler and full accessible labels. Compact chart/calendar/navigation roles are explicit exceptions in current source, not a global size prescription.

Check long names, errors, units and signs, ambiguous digits, and relevant Ukrainian glyphs (І і Ї ї Є є Ґ ґ). Use actual bundled fonts for visual evidence and tabular numerals where comparative measurements need them.

Font-family selection applies only to a named family/design task. Compare identical content/composition, retain license/provenance and verify fallback; do not download or refresh assets as a side effect of a wrapping fix.
Report the role/caller, bounded correction or finding, checks and remaining limits. CSS specimens do not prove Flutter scaling, and static renders do not establish device or owner acceptance.

Paths are relative to the repository root. Unqualified shared filenames are under `lib/presentation/shared/`; `widgets/` means `lib/presentation/widgets/`. Values come from existing domain/ViewModel contracts.

`DocumentSection` in `document_section.dart` · Required existing `children`; optional padding (16 dp), joinPrevious/joinNext for lazy month slices · Flat surfaceSubtle, radius 8 dp, zero elevation. No new callback, clipping, semantic merging or fixed text height. Local Material preserves child ink/focus feedback. Keep source-owned chart/calendar widths and all existing actions · Tonight, Plan, Logbook, Night, Moon, Weather, Library, Settings, Record result; `test/presentation/shared/document_section_test.dart`

`SkyDarknessWidget` in `widgets/sky_darkness_widget.dart` · `embedded:false` keeps standalone framing; `embedded:true` uses the containing document group's frame/inset · Same remembered disclosure key, top sibling rule, Bortle/SQM/Unknown, independent provenance, picker and external-map action in both variants · Planner `home_screen.dart` uses embedded; `sky_darkness_context_test.dart` covers standalone facts and embedded control/persistence behavior

`StatusBlock` in `lib/presentation/shared/status_block.dart` · Required `state:FitState`; optional `needed/usable:Duration?`, `reason`, `missing`, `keyNumbers:List<(String,String)>`, `action:Widget?` · Only show measured headline when both durations exist. Missing input uses its word, never fabricated zero. Action slot is caller-owned; the widget calculates nothing · `test/presentation/shared/status_block_test.dart`; Tonight instance; planner `plan_status.dart` uses `StatusBlock.headline` only; isolated trial

`PlanStateLabel(PlanState)` in `plan_state.dart` · States: notSaved, saved, savedChanged, tracking, completed, partly, notDone, oldLog. `PlanState.from` consumes status/savedBefore/legacy and optional resultKind · Persistence/result state is distinct from fit; do not infer “Saved” from “Fits”. Result states have existing icons. Current code supports partly; historical adoption text predates that implementation · Native gallery and `test/presentation/shared/plan_state_test.dart`; Logbook/planner

`CollapsibleSection` in `collapsible_section.dart` · Required sectionKey/title/child; optional summary/initiallyOpen; remembered form or controlled pair `open` **and** `onToggle` · Supply both controlled properties together; otherwise retain DisclosureViewModel. Closed child is not built. Summary remains visible; header has expanded semantics and 48 dp target. Reduced motion omits AnimatedSize · `test/presentation/shared/collapsible_section_test.dart`; isolated trial

`ChangeMark` in `change_mark.dart` · Required value and child; value change triggers the existing transient cue · Does not persist or compute domain state. Preserve the original value/change boundary and reduced-motion behavior · `test/presentation/widgets/capture_outputs_test.dart` and actual planner callers

`AltitudeChartWidget` in `widgets/altitude_chart_widget.dart` · Required opportunity; optional moonAltitudesDeg, zoneId, nowUtc, captureEndUtc; `TimelineDensity.full/compact` · Full has grid/legend; compact retains timing information. Existing painter/timeline data owns scientific geometry. Use chart tokens, not approximate CSS astronomy · `test/presentation/design_system/u_renders_test.dart`; `widgets/tonight_opportunity_widget.dart` contains a call, but that wrapper has no production instantiation at this snapshot; current night-browser timeline is separate

`StackingGainGraph` in `widgets/capture_plan/stacking_gain_graph.dart` · Required curve and groupLabel; optional caption and recorded frame count · Graph is relative improvement over integration time normalized to the plan (1.00×), with plan/comparison and optional recorded marks. Preserve the existing curve and per-group exposure/filter meaning; no absolute SNR or universal score. Hybrid functional gradients are presentation, not new science · `widgets/capture_plan/capture_budget_summary.dart`; existing graph/curve checks and planner

`NightBarSection` in `widgets/night_browser_sections.dart` · Existing browser ViewModel/site providers; `compact`, `home` presentation flags · Two exact-boundary jump actions, 16 dp before the 48 dp slider region. Current instant/state stays visible. Legend, encoding warning and exact intervals are behind the initially closed `Exact times & reading key` action; opening it changes no preview/plan data. Preserve sky/Moon lanes and five-minute browse semantics · Tonight and Night & Moon detail; `night_moon_browse_test.dart`, actual screen callers and corresponding render fixtures

`WeatherDetailsTable(rows:, background:)` in `widgets/weather_details_table.dart` implements the current Forecast details composition. It accepts the caller's nine existing cell widgets/row decorations and document surface color. One intrinsic `Table` fixes its leading Local time column at 96 dp; its actual render children keep painting, hit tests and semantic bounds synchronized during horizontal scroll. Row heights follow full text and the user's scaler without a second layout/measurement loop. Per-cell semantics retain reading order and expose metric cells beside time when accessibility requests reveal. Only the Weather details caller adopts it; loading/unavailable/no-dark branches, model/provenance, units, dated offsets/DST, unknowns and partial-hour qualifications remain caller-owned. `weather_fixed_time_test.dart` covers three themes/phone widths, scaling/direction/update smoke, reveal, exact metric/imperial DST readouts and snapshot integrity. The widget test does not establish physical-device, owner or TalkBack acceptance.

Use `NightTimeFormatter` / `QuantityText` and the existing word helpers for dates, units and labels. For every touched component record the needed variant, state, slots, input provenance and relevant check; do not analyse every category for an unrelated change.

Paths below are relative to the repository root. Unqualified shared filenames are under `lib/presentation/shared/`; `app_button_styles.dart` is under `lib/core/theme/`. Inspect the named API before editing; this index routes to source and does not replace it.

Material FilledButton / OutlinedButton / TextButton; `lib/core/theme/app_theme.dart`, `app_button_styles.dart` · `onPressed`, child text/icon; filled primary, outlined secondary, text tertiary; destructive styles are explicit · `onPressed: null` disables; maintain visible action words and 48 dp targets. Do not swap a spinner in a way that changes control geometry or removes its accessible name · `test/core/theme/controls_theme_test.dart`; native `test/presentation/design_system/gallery_entries.dart`

TextFormField; `coordinate_input.dart` · `CoordinateInput.parse`, `validateLatitude`, `validateLongitude`; optional string input, nullable parsed result, nullable validation message · Decimal comma is accepted; non-finite/out-of-range/empty values are errors. A validator is not a generated replacement field widget · `test/presentation/shared/location_input_test.dart`; site editor

`site_form_input.dart`, `target_form_input.dart`, `rig_input_text.dart` · Existing domain validators and field copy; inspect the relevant methods rather than inventing another API · Keep units, range errors, camera-class requirements and edited drafts. Field loading/error/disabled presentation belongs to the adopting form · Existing site/target/rig editor tests; search by class name

`askUnsavedChanges(context, plan: ...)` in `confirmation_patterns.dart` · Returns `UnsavedChoice.save/discard/cancel`; `plan` required · Cancel/back/outside = cancel. Caller performs Save/Discard and handles failure; prompt itself does not persist · `test/presentation/design_system/design_system_gallery_test.dart`; planner leaving flow

`confirmDestructive(context, title:, message:, action:)` in same source · Required item-specific title and consequence; action defaults to Delete · True only for explicit confirmation; false on cancellation/dismissal. No destructive work inside the prompt · Native gallery overlay checks

`DeleteButton`, `SwipeToDelete`, `showUndo` in `delete_patterns.dart` · Button: tooltip/onPressed; swipe: itemKey/onDelete/child; undo: message/onUndo · Swipe/button delegate to the adopter. Stored-record confirmation differs from an editable-plan Undo. Respect existing stale-recovery guards in the actual caller · Native gallery and existing delete/Undo task tests

For selection: radio/segments express one of a few mutually exclusive values; searchable select expresses a larger single-choice set; checkboxes express independent selections; switches apply a binary setting. An option count does not change the underlying choice semantics. Error text must name the problem and recovery; colour is additional information.
For a requested component comparison, inspect the existing control/caller and compare concrete input/state behavior using identical content. Historical examples do not replace current source.
Paths are relative to the repository root. Keep existing routing authoritative.

`lib/presentation/navigation/app_shell.dart` · Tonight, Logbook, Library, Settings; inspect current router integration · Preserve branch state and Back behavior. Tonight remains the tab name while the page title can name a different selected night · Existing navigation tests; actual Tonight screen

`ContextLine` in `lib/presentation/shared/context_line.dart` · Required nullable `siteName:String?`, `night:CalendarDate?`, callbacks `onSite/onNight`; defaults `noSiteLabel=ContextLine.noSite` ("No site set"), `framed=false`, `compact=false`; optional nullable `siteDescription`, `zoneId`, `nightStartUtc` · Default wrapping layout or compact single-line choices; optional card framing. Site and night are independent actions; night visibility follows `night != null`, zone caption requires both `night` and `nightStartUtc`. The widget does not enforce consistency from `siteName` alone · `test/presentation/shared/context_line_test.dart` and actual Tonight caller; gallery/isolated trial exercise component capabilities, not current screen adoption

`pickNight` in the same file · Existing calendar picker returning `CalendarDate?`; inspect the current signature · Null means cancelled. Selecting a civil evening date must not shift through UTC conversion or implicitly save a draft · ContextLine tests and current caller

`DetailScaffold` in `lib/presentation/shared/detail_scaffold.dart` · Required `title`, `summary:Widget`; optional textual `context`, `zoneRule`, `sections:List<Widget>`, `actions:List<Widget>?` · Title wraps in body with header semantics; app bar retains Back/actions. Summary reports facts. One zone caption, discoverable disclosure for long sections · Native gallery detail-template checks; no production `DetailScaffold(...)` instantiation under `lib/` at this snapshot. Current detail screens have their own Hybrid composition

**Tonight:** `lib/presentation/screens/tonight/tonight_home_screen.dart` (`_Context`) passes `compact:true`, `noSiteLabel:ContextLine.setSite` ("Set site"), the compact `SiteLabel` display and full `siteDescription:SiteLabel.of(siteVm)`. It leaves `framed:false` at its default, passes `planVm.eveningDate` and `zoneId`, and omits `nightStartUtc`, so no inline zone caption appears. `onSite/onNight` call `showHomeSiteSheet/showHomeNightSheet` in `home_context_sheets.dart`: Manage sites and the direct calendar respectively (TD-120).

**Planner:** `lib/presentation/screens/home/home_screen.dart` no longer constructs `ContextLine`. Its `HybridPlanRow` (`planner.context`, "Site and night") opens `PlanContextScreen` in `plan_context_screen.dart` via `openPlanContext`; site/night draft choices use Apply changes, while Close discards unapplied choices. The planner still uses `ContextLine.noSite` and `pickNight` for its copy action. Do not apply Tonight's compact/direct-calendar behavior to this flow.

**No site:** callers must supply `night:null` and no night instant; the component does not infer those from a null name. Tonight obtains the null date from `SessionPlanViewModel.eveningDate` / `sessionNight` when `SiteViewModel.isDefaultLocation` is true. The site action remains available as "Set site"; default component wording remains "No site set". Never compute a night for the placeholder location.

**Accessibility and layout:** each choice retains a 48 × 48 logical px minimum, an enabled button semantics action, its own Choose a site/night hint and a full-label tooltip. Compact choices follow their content with a 4 dp gap; the site flexes/ellipsizes when needed and the date keeps its natural width. Compact site semantics use `siteDescription ?? siteName ?? ContextLine.noSite`, while the default wrapping variant uses `siteName ?? ContextLine.noSite`. `noSiteLabel` changes visible wording, not the semantic fallback. Both variants expose the full "Night of …" label; `siteDescription` affects only compact site semantics/tooltip. `framed:true` remains an optional `context.card` wrapper for either variant, not a requirement for a screen.

Callbacks and slots are the Flutter equivalents of editable properties and nested instances. Keep icon/text geometry stable when changing state, allow wrapping variants to wrap, retain compact variants' full-label semantics/tooltips and preserve separate accessible action names. Browser analogues do not establish actual routing or Material semantics.

The `design/reference/` website contains reference specimens and an application map. Use actual Flutter routes and tests; historical Visual Atlas evidence lives under `design/reference/atlas/` and does not establish current router behavior.

Current mapping guidance carried forward from the 2026-10-24 token/source reconciliation, not a new token authority. Read only the roles needed by the task and inspect their definition and actual caller. Repository paths below are relative to the root. [AGENTS](../../../../AGENTS.md) describes the shared source routes and evidence limits.
`surface-default` · `Theme.of(context).scaffoldBackgroundColor` (`ThemeData`) · The page canvas

`surface-subtle` · `HybridTokens.surfaceSubtle`; generic theme surfaces remain `ColorScheme.surface` and field `cardColor` · Quiet Hybrid grouping; selected root navigation and Concept B `DocumentSection` use this role. Field `ColorScheme.surface` is black, while `surfaceSubtle` and `cardColor` use the dark-red grouping surface
`surface-raised` · `AppPalette.surfaceRaised`, `surfaceContainerHigh` · Dialogs, menus and sheets above the page
`surface-sunken` · `HybridTokens.surfaceSunken` · Recessed Moon-lane tracks and the Moon-up legend well in `night_browser_sections.dart`; distinct from raised overlays
`text-primary` · `AppPalette.textPrimary` · Answers, values and meaningful headings
`text-secondary` · `AppPalette.textSecondary` · Labels and supporting explanations
`text-tertiary` · `AppPalette.textTertiary` · Provenance, time zone and freshness; never hide necessary instructions here
`text-disabled` · `AppPalette.textDisabled` · Disabled controls only, not normal metadata
`border-subtle` · `AppPalette.border` · Decorative dividers and group outlines
`border-control` · `AppPalette.controlBorder`, `ColorScheme.outline` · A boundary needed to recognise a control
`status-*` · `AppPalette.statusFits/Tight/DoesNotFit/NoWindow/Neutral` via `FitText.color` · Fit verdicts in `StatusBlock`; retain the status word and reason

`state-*` · `AppPalette.stateUnsaved/Settled/Quiet` for `PlanState.tone`; compact badges use the Hybrid pairs below · Persistence/result state, distinct from fit; a tone helper is not the badge's current colour map

Compact persistence/result badges · `HybridTokens.success/successWash`, `caution/cautionWash`, `selection` with `AppPalette.textPrimary` · `PlanStateLabel` and `EntryStateBadge`: Saved/Tracking/Completed use success; Not saved/Saved · changed/Partly use caution; Not done/Old log use neutral selection. Not recorded (`EntryStateBadge.due`) uses caution. These are state words, not fit or image-quality verdicts

Selected weather hour · `HybridTokens.selectedHourFill/selectedHourText/selectedHourRule` · `weather_hybrid_view.dart` hour axis: fill, text and bottom rule, with selected semantics. `hourBackground/hourText` exist but have no presentation callers at this baseline; do not substitute them

`sky-day/civil/nautical/astro/dark` · `HybridTokens.skyDay/skyCivil/skyNautical/skyAstronomical/skyDark` · Native night-browser timeline and legend in `night_browser_sections.dart`; existing sky intervals own the geometry. `AppPalette.chartDay/chartTwilight/chartDark` still serve the altitude chart, not this five-role ramp

`moon-up`, `moon-free` · `HybridTokens.moonUp/moonFree` · Native night-browser lanes and legend; preserve position, thickness and text cues. `AppPalette.chartMoon` remains the altitude chart's Moon line; it is not the Moon-up lane token

Weather dew caution · `HybridTokens.caution` · `weather_hybrid_view.dart` dew-margin heuristic text, not a condensation forecast or fit verdict. `weatherCaution` is defined but has no presentation callers at this baseline
Weather freshness/gap notices · `HybridTokens.weatherNotice` · `weather_hybrid_view.dart` aging/stale, unknown-gap and offline-cache notices; preserve their text and source/freshness meaning

Read actual values from `lib/core/theme/app_colors.dart`, `app_palette.dart`, `hybrid_tokens.dart` and `app_theme.dart`; historical Visual Atlas files under `design/reference/atlas/` are reference evidence, not production constants.

Caller map (under `lib/presentation/`): `navigation/app_shell.dart` and `shared/document_section.dart` read `surfaceSubtle`; `widgets/night_browser_sections.dart` reads sunken/sky/Moon roles; `widgets/weather_hybrid_view.dart` reads selected-hour and weather-notice roles; `shared/plan_state.dart` defines both the palette tone helper and Hybrid badges; `shared/night_text.dart` defines `FitText.color`, used by `shared/status_block.dart`; `widgets/altitude_chart_widget.dart` retains AppPalette chart roles. `AppTheme._withTokens` installs both extensions for light/dark/field. Similar values or names do not make these APIs interchangeable or require migrating every AppPalette caller.
